title: Google Chrome 158 Released With 204 Security Fixes, Including 6 Critical Vulnerabilities
content_md: Google released Chrome 158 to the desktop Stable channel on November 17, 2026, with 204 security fixes, including six critical vulnerabilities. The patched builds are 158.0.8127.36 for Linux and 158.0.8127.36 or 158.0.8127.37 for Windows and macOS. In its Stable channel advisory, Google said the update would reach users over the coming days and weeks.
